{{Quote|I must get you to safety, General!|Zak, to [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]|audio=ZakSafetyGeneral.flac|<ref name="Ambush" />}}
'''Zak''' was a [[Clone Captain/Legends|clone trooper captain]] who served in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] was tasked with transporting [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] to the neutral [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rugosa/Legends|Rugosa]] to meet with the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[King/Legends|King]] [[Katuunko/Legends|Katuunko]], in order to urge the nearby [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Toydaria/Legends|Toydaria]] to side with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the moon, Zak's [[Zak's Consular-class cruiser/Legends|''Consular''-class cruiser]] was ambushed by two [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|frigates]], and Yoda was forced to take an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] to the surface of Rugosa, leaving Zak and the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] to retreat.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Toydarian royal delegation, this is the Republic envoy, please respond. General, the Toydarian's beacon is active on the moon, but all our transmissions are being jammed.|Zak, to Yoda, on arrival over Rugosa|audio=TransmissionsAreBeingJammed-Ambush.flac|<ref name="Ambush" />}}
Zak was the name taken by a [[Clone Captain/Legends|clone trooper captain]]<ref name="The Clone Wars: Ambush">''[[The Clone Wars: Ambush]]''</ref> [[Cloning/Legends|born]] and raised on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]<ref name="SWE" /> to fight in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|Navy]]. After<ref name="Ambush" /> the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|outbreak]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Chro">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Zak and [[Gender/Legends|his]] clone brothers joined the fight against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Ambush" />

[[File:Zak_worried.png|thumb|left|230px|Zak, concerned with Yoda's plan to depart in an escape pod]]
[[21 BBY/Legends|During]] the [[Clone Wars/Legends|war]],<ref name="SW Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> the Republic sought to build a base in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], and [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] arranged negotiations to take place with the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[King/Legends|King]] [[Katuunko/Legends|Katuunko]] on the coral [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rugosa/Legends|Rugosa]].<ref name="Prelude">''[[The Clone Wars: Prelude]]''</ref> The Confederacy, however, intercepted the transmission on their newly built [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]], [[Skytop Station/Legends|Skytop Station]].<ref name="DB Katuunko">{{DB|character|katuunko|Katuunko, King}}</ref> [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], along with several [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guards]], was sent to Rugosa in a [[Zak's Consular-class cruiser/Legends|''Consular''-class cruiser]] under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Zak. Shortly after arriving in Rugosa's [[Star system/Legends|system]], Zak attempted to make contact with the [[Toydarian royal delegation/Legends|Toydarian royal delegation]], but the transmissions were [[Jammer/Legends|jammed]] by the Confederacy.<ref name="Ambush" />

When Zak reported this to Yoda, their [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)/Legends|cruiser]] was suddenly ambushed by two Confederate [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class frigates]] that had dropped out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. The Confederate [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] were larger and more heavily-armed than the Republic vessel, and quickly weakened the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser's]] [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]].<ref name="Ambush" /> Zak ordered his [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|pilots]] to return fire<ref name="The Clone Wars: Ambush" /> and wanted to retreat immediately, more concerned about Yoda's safety than completing his mission. However, the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] ordered Zak to launch an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] to take him to Rugosa's surface so that he could continue his [[Battle of Rugosa/Legends|mission]]. Zak was concerned that the pod would be shot down by the frigates, but Yoda ordered the Captain to launch all of the pods to distract the Separatists. Once Yoda had departed, Zak and the Republic frigate escaped to hyperspace. Yoda safely reached the moon's surface and successfully completed the mission.<ref name="Ambush" /><ref name="The Clone Wars: Ambush" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Quickly now, reach the planet's surface, we must.''"<br />"''In an ''escape pod'', sir? The enemy will fire at anything we launch!''"<br />"''Then launch all of them you will, hmm?|Yoda and Zak|audio=InAnEscapePodSir-Ambush.flac|<ref name="Ambush" />}}
Zak was trained on Kamino,<ref name="Clone Wars Campaign Guide">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> where he was raised to be loyal to the Republic as well as his Jedi commanders. He would have aborted his mission to Rugosa in order to save Yoda, and because the [[Jedi General/Legends|general's]] safety was at risk, Zak was bold enough to question Yoda's plan to travel in an escape pod to the moon's surface. Zak's calm demeanor allowed him to bring the Republic cruiser to safety once Yoda had departed the ship. Zak had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and tan skin.<ref name="Ambush" /> As a [[Human/Legends|Human]] male clone of Jango Fett,<ref name="clone troopers" /> he stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="SWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zak first appeared in "[[Ambush]]," the first episode in [[The Clone Wars: Season One|season one]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series.<ref name="Ambush" /> He was first identified by name in [[The Clone Wars: Ambush|the young readers book]] that was based on the episode.<ref name="The Clone Wars: Ambush" /> Like all clone troopers in the television series, Zak was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]].<ref name="Episode Guide: Ambush">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode001.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Ambush}}</ref>
